cohort: A total of 178 pregnant women were recruited in their first trimester, categorized as euthyroid (TSH 0.1-2.4 mIU/L) or subclinical hypothyroid (TSH 2.5-4 mIU/L).
finding: The study found no significant differences in most foetomaternal outcomes between women with subclinical hypothyroidism and euthyroid women, except for a higher rate of NICU admission in the SCH group.
mod_finding: Among women with subclinical hypothyroidism, the proportion of induced labour was lower in TPOAb-positive women compared to TPOAb-negative women.
